notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers,

The year is drawing to an end. This is the time to give you an update on the game's development. To be honest, we didn't achieve our goal of implementing a new game engine for Aunewyth. The plan was to move from GameMaker to Unity. Yet we didn't get satisfying results so far. That's the bad news.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43444244/d5a6fc0b655201ce7ebfdd3fb534ec4b548bf198.jpg[/img]
But now for the good news. I have been working on the upcoming content for the game. The plan is to implement new content into the game in the not too distant future. Here is a list of what to expect.

[list]
[*]Episode 1 - A Toad in the Swamp (already playable - continues the storyline after offending Adana)
[*]Episode 2  - The Mylia Flower (almost complete - continues the storyline after just visiting Adana)
[*]Episode 3 - Guards of the Vale (in the making - continues the storyline after meeting with Ackley)
[*]Episode 4 - The Forlorn Grove (in the making - continues the storyline after talking to the elder)
[*]Main Game - a new version of the game (in the making - contains all episodes plus the base game)
[/list]
We are working on a fully illustrated version of Episode 1 and have completed over 80 illustrations so far. However, creating a fully illustrated game seems out of reach under the given circumstances. We have therefore decided to create partially illustrated versions of the other episodes and the base game for now.

As always, you are welcome to share your thoughts.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2192400/discussions/0/3768982992498189820/]Feedback Thread[/url]

Good luck on your journey!

Episode 3 - Guards of the Vale (in the making - continues the storyline after meeting with Ackley)
Episode 4 - The Forlorn Grove (in the making - continues the storyline after talking to the elder)
Main Game - a new version of the game (in the making - contains all episodes plus the base game)

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers,

This update adds new content to the base game. 

It basically changes the beginning of the game so that the first six encounters now look (and feel) a little different to smoothen the overall experience. Furthermore, I changed the music for the starting screen.

The base game (Aunewyth Forest, Mountain Road, Purefire Path) should be fully playable.

There are up to four different epilogues depending on your choices. Thank you for your feedback.

Good luck on your journey!

notes.title: Community Feedback Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers. 

This is a small update to add new controls to the game. 

From now on, you may also use [W] and [S] to move through the game.

[Up] and [Down] can (as always) also be used to move through the game.

Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Greetings Wayfarers,

The new episode has been finished and is fully playable now.

[i][b]A Toad in the Swamp[/b][/i] will take you on a journey to a new area of Aunewyth Valley.

Introducing [i]Adventure Mode[/i], players will have to tread carefully to avoid biting the dust.

There will also be new ways of interacting with the environment to alter the outcome of the 
game. These interactions may vary with each playthrough depending on the choices you make.

Do you have the courage to embark on an unexpected journey full of hazard and adventure?

Buckle up and get ready for a [i]toadally[/i] different experience.

Good luck on your journey!

tags.feature: Introducing [i]Adventure Mode[/i], players will have to tread carefully to avoid biting the dust.

There will also be new ways of interacting with the environment to alter the outcome of the 
game.

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content: Greetings Wayfarers. Aunewyth will be launching tomorrow. So I just wanted to give you a quick overview of what to expect from the game in its current state. Aunewyth features three locations. Aunewyth Forest will be fully playable while the other two locations (Mountain Road and Purefire Path) remain unfinished.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content: Greetings Wayfarers. With the launch date closing in, I'm doing my best to improve the game. As you may know, Aunewyth is a game with a focus on decision making. And from now on, players will be able to change their decision within a few seconds.
